title: Make bundled Grogu skills discoverable
body: Resolve harness friction #45 by ensuring repository-distributed skills remain discoverable when Grogu launches outside its source checkout; add regression tests and docs.

log.text: Reproduced friction 45: custom instruction directories load Grogu instructions but Copilot skill listing outside the source checkout contains only built-ins. Official CLI docs require project or personal skill roots or a session plugin; use a launcher-scoped plugin to avoid persistent user config changes.

Implemented a session-scoped Grogu plugin, launcher injection, setup validation, docs, and installation/launcher/live Copilot discovery tests. Targeted tests, live invocation, and the 536-test suite pass.
PR #42; full suite and live Copilot skill invocation passed.
Reclaimed to merge current origin/main with Windows support into PR #42 and re-run full/live verification.
Merged origin/main including PR #39 Windows support with no conflicts. Targeted Windows/skill tests, 552-test full suite, and live external-CWD Copilot skill invocation pass.
PR #42 refreshed with current main; ready for CI/review.

Windows CI exposed two pre-Windows assumptions in the skill-discovery tests: direct setup.sh execution and an extensionless fake Copilot. Updating only the test harness to respect the merged platform contract.

Windows CI failure was limited to skill-discovery test harness assumptions. setup.sh coverage now skips Windows by contract, and the fake Copilot uses a .cmd wrapper there. Local 552-test suite and live E2E pass.
PR #42 updated after Windows CI integration fix; awaiting rerun.
